digest.component_or_area: code-review extension seam and project criterion runtime
propositions: The code-review extension seam is incomplete: project-routed criteria are not dynamically fanned into Pass 1, not resolved by the eval surface, and not consulted through repository-aware routing in Pass 3.

The four-phase review contract must be enforced such that Pass 1 discovers only, Pass 2 assesses binary validity/impact only, Pass 3 decides deterministically without LLM, and Pass 4 coaches without re-verifying or re-adjudicating.

A project-owned criterion project.review-phase-boundaries must be authored with balanced eval corpus (RP-F1..F6 findings, RP-N1..N6 non-findings), block_threshold 0.90, and blocking_enabled false to remain advisory-only during pilot.

The generic seam repair must map logical project.<name> ids to physical code-review-project-<name> ids, support dynamic criterion fan-in, enable repository-effective Pass 3 routing, and preserve compatibility for overlay-absent repositories.
Live dogfooding in Gerrit must capture a valid positive control, an invalid cross-phase directive probe, and demonstrate phase-compliant final submission before the pilot is considered complete.
